responseText:
I can’t read or summarize the PDF without the file or its contents. To produce an accurate, verifiable summary I need one of the following and a few preferences from you.

What to provide (pick one)
- Upload the PDF file (preferred).  
- OR provide a publicly accessible link to the PDF (ensure the link is accessible).  
- OR paste the PDF text or key excerpts (e.g., executive summary, financial tables, charts).  
- OR upload screenshots of pages you want summarized.

Required preferences (quick checklist — reply with your choices)
1. Summary type (pick one)
   - One-line TL;DR
   - Short bullets (5–8 key points / ~150 words)
   - 1-page executive summary (~300–500 words)
   - Detailed summary with page-by-page notes
2. Audience / tone
   - Executive / board
   - Investors / analysts
   - Internal operations / product teams
   - Legal / compliance
3. Focus areas (select any)
   - Financial results (revenue, profit, margins, guidance)
   - KPIs / operational metrics
   - Key drivers and causes of variance
   - Risks, contingencies, and outlook
   - Management commentary / quotes
   - Charts & tables (extract numbers into CSV)
   - Footnotes / accounting policies
4. Level of numeric detail
   - High-level trends only
   - Exact figures and percent changes (with page citations)
   - Extract full tables into CSV
5. Citations and quotes
   - Include page numbers for claims? (yes/no)
   - Include verbatim quotes from the document? (yes/no)
6. Confidentiality / redaction
   - Any PII or confidential content to omit or anonymize? (yes/no — specify)
7. Output format
   - Plain text reply
   - Bulleted summary + short recommendations
   - Word / Google Docs export (you must upload the file after I prepare it)
   - CSV extract of tables
8. Deadline / length constraints
   - When do you need it? Any maximum length?

Notes and constraints you should know
- If the PDF contains charts/tables, I’ll cite page numbers and will avoid inferring exact values from images unless the data/table is selectable; if you want exact numeric extraction, provide the text/table or a higher-resolution image or let me extract tables from the file upload.  
- For legal, accounting, or investment decisions, I’ll cite pages and quotes; you should verify with the original PDF.  
- I cannot fetch files from private systems unless you provide the file or an accessible link.

If you’d like, reply with: (A) the PDF upload or link, and (B) your choices for the checklist above. If you can’t upload, paste the table of contents or the executive summary and I’ll proceed from that.
